## Description and Rationale

With a background in aviation, I am a solo aviation data analyst that wants to analyse bottlenecks with publicly available aviation data and understanding graphics. I believe this could help analyse and find a solution differently and analyse a potential bottleneck before it is accruing. I have decided to register so that I can show the capabilities of aviation analytics without being an insider.
